svg.aria-label: $ whoami wahyu fikri · software qa engineer · bandung, indonesia $ cat about.txt I automate end-to-end tests with Playwright, test REST APIs with Postman, and look for security flaws (OWASP Top 10) before a release goes out. Before QA I built web apps with Laravel and Next.js, so I read the code I test and write bug reports a developer can act on. $ ls now/ qa-engineer@exodrinks learning: cypress, docker, pentest open-to: qa-automation, software-testing
